# Formatho

> Privacy-first developer tools: 120+ free online utilities that run 100% client-side in the browser. Nothing entered is uploaded, logged, or stored. No account needed.

Every tool page states what the tool does, how to use it step by step, and answers common questions. Free, private, runs in your browser.

## Tools

### Blockchain
Web3 and blockchain tools: Keccak-256 hashing, ABI encoding, EVM unit conversion, vanity address generation, and chain readers for EVM, Solana, Polkadot, Cardano, and Cosmos.
- [Vanity Address Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/vanity-eth — Generate Ethereum addresses with a custom prefix or suffix. Keys are created in your browser and never transmitted.
- [Cosmos Account Reader]: https://formatho.com/tools/cosmos-reader — ATOM and token balances, delegations, and rewards for any Cosmos SDK account - plus a bech32 converter for every chain prefix.
- [Solana Account Reader]: https://formatho.com/tools/solana-account-reader — Look up Solana accounts, decode SPL token accounts, and derive PDAs - client-side via any Solana RPC.
- [Polkadot Substrate Reader]: https://formatho.com/tools/polkadot-reader — Substrate chain info, raw storage queries, and SS58 address conversion for Polkadot, Kusama, and local nodes.
- [Cardano Address Reader]: https://formatho.com/tools/cardano-reader — ADA balance, UTxO count, and stake info for any Cardano address via the keyless Koios API.
- [EVM Contract Reader]: https://formatho.com/tools/contract-reader — Paste an ABI and call view functions on any deployed contract via your own RPC endpoint. Works on every EVM chain.
- [Function Selector Calculator]: https://formatho.com/tools/function-selector — Compute 4-byte Solidity function selectors from signatures with Keccak-256. Batch mode for ABI work.
- [ENS Namehash Calculator]: https://formatho.com/tools/ens-namehash — Derive EIP-137 namehash and labelhash values for any ENS name, with the full derivation chain.
- [Cosmos Address Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/cosmos-address-generator — Generate addresses for Cosmos Hub (ATOM), Osmosis (OSMO), Juno (JUNO), Akash (AKT), Injective (INJ), Kava, Stargaze, Secret Network and more from BIP39 seed phrases.
- [Multi-Chain Wallet]: https://formatho.com/tools/multi-chain-keys — Generate keys & addresses for multiple blockchains from one mnemonic, derive addresses from keys, and validate checksums.
- [Address Checksum (EIP-55)]: https://formatho.com/tools/address-checksum — Validate and checksum Ethereum addresses. Prevent spoofed address attacks.
- [EVM Unit Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/evm-converter — Convert between Wei, Gwei, and Ether.
- [Keccak-256 Hasher]: https://formatho.com/tools/keccak256 — Generate Keccak-256 hashes for Ethereum.
- [Solidity to Opcodes]: https://formatho.com/tools/solidity-to-opcodes — Compile Solidity to EVM opcodes.
- [ABI Encoder & Decoder]: https://formatho.com/tools/abi-encoder — Encode/decode Solidity ABI parameters, function selectors, and transaction calldata.
- [RWA Asset Swap]: https://formatho.com/tools/rwa-swap — Swap RWA tokens, stablecoins, and native assets across 15+ EVM chains. Cross-chain routing via LI.FI.
- [RWA Tokenization Lab]: https://formatho.com/tools/rwa-deploy-lab — Deploy ERC-20 mirror tokens for stocks (AAPL, AMZN), fractional ownership contracts, and custom tokenization contracts on-chain via MetaMask or Rabby.
- [Private Key to Address Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/address-from-key — Derive addresses for Ethereum, Bitcoin, Solana, and more from a private key. Runs entirely in browser.
- [BLS12-381 Signature Generator & Verifier]: https://formatho.com/tools/bls-signature — Generate BLS12-381 signatures, verify signatures, and aggregate multiple signatures into one. 100% client-side, privacy-first.

### Crypto & Security
Hashing (Argon2id, bcrypt, SHA), encryption, RSA keys, password analysis - all client-side.
- [SAML Request & Response Decoder]: https://formatho.com/tools/saml-decoder — Decode SAML AuthnRequest and Response messages - base64 plus raw-deflate - with pretty-printed XML. Essential for Okta, Entra ID and Shibboleth debugging. 100% client-side.
- [OIDC Authorization URL & PKCE Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/oidc-url-builder — Build OAuth 2.0 / OIDC authorize URLs with state, nonce and S256 PKCE code challenges. Works with Okta, Auth0, Entra ID, Keycloak.
- [Token Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/token-generator — Generate secure random tokens with customizable length and character sets.
- [Hash Text]: https://formatho.com/tools/hash-text — Generate Argon2id, bcrypt, PBKDF2, MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384, SHA-512, BLAKE2b, and Poseidon hashes online. 100% client-side Argon2id password hashing for maximum security.
- [Bcrypt]: https://formatho.com/tools/bcrypt — Generate and verify Bcrypt password hashes.
- [UUID Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/uuid — Generate UUIDs (Universally Unique Identifiers). Supports v1, v4, and more.
- [ULID Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/ulid-generator — Generate ULIDs (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifiers).
- [Encrypt/Decrypt]: https://formatho.com/tools/encryption — Encrypt and decrypt text using various algorithms.
- [BIP39 Passphrase]: https://formatho.com/tools/bip39-generator — Generate BIP39 mnemonic phrases for cryptocurrency wallets.
- [HMAC Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/hmac-generator — Generate HMAC hash codes with various algorithms.
- [RSA Key Pair]: https://formatho.com/tools/rsa-key-pair-generator — Generate RSA public/private key pairs.
- [Password Strength]: https://formatho.com/tools/password-strength-analyser — Analyze password strength and get improvement suggestions.
- [AI Crypto Price Forecasts]: https://formatho.com/tools/crypto-forecasts — 30-day crypto price predictions using Google TimesFM 2.5. Privacy-first AI forecasts for BTC, ETH, SOL, and more.
- [TOTP Generator]: https://formatho.com/tools/otp-code-generator — Generate TOTP codes from secrets. Privacy-first tool.
- [PDF Signature Checker]: https://formatho.com/tools/pdf-signature-checker — Check and validate digital signatures in PDF files. Privacy-first tool.

- [Case Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/case-converter — Convert text between different cases (camelCase, snake_case, etc.).
- [Text to NATO]: https://formatho.com/tools/text-to-nato-alphabet — Convert text to NATO phonetic alphabet.
- [Text to Binary]: https://formatho.com/tools/text-to-binary — Convert text to binary and vice versa.
- [JSON <> YAML]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-yaml — Convert JSON to YAML and YAML to JSON instantly.
- [JSON <> CSV]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-csv — Convert JSON to CSV and CSV to JSON format instantly.
- [Temperature]: https://formatho.com/tools/temperature-converter — Convert temperatures between Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin, and Rankine.
- [XML ↔ JSON]: https://formatho.com/tools/xml-json — Bi-directional XML to JSON converter with real-time conversion and clipboard support.
- [BPMN to Visio]: https://formatho.com/tools/bpmn-to-visio — Convert BPMN process diagrams into Microsoft Visio compatible formats.
- [Visio File Viewer]: https://formatho.com/tools/visio-viewer — View Microsoft Visio diagrams (.vsdx, .vsd) directly in your browser.
- [json-to-toml]: https://formatho.com/tools/json-to-toml — json-to-toml - free, privacy-first, and 100% client-side.
- [List Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/list-converter — Convert lists between different formats (comma, newline, JSON, etc).
- [Markdown to HTML Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/markdown-to-html — Convert Markdown to HTML with syntax highlighting.
- [Text to Unicode Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/text-to-unicode — Convert text to Unicode code points and HTML entities.
- [TOML to JSON Converter]: https://formatho.com/tools/toml-to-json — Convert TOML configuration files to JSON format.
